# Open_Analysis

> Open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) PCB signal, power and RF integrity analysis suite: board ingest (KiCad, IPC-2581), impedance, rule checks (ERC), DC IR drop and EM S-parameters. AI agents are first-class users: every operation is one catalog command available as an MCP tool (`oa-mcp`) and as `oa ... --json`. Results are structured, size-bounded and carry an accuracy class; writes to KiCad files are always propose-then-confirm.

## Agent guide
- [Guide for agents using Open_Analysis](docs/agents/AGENTS.md): setup, the M1 workflow, reading accuracy, budgets, propose and apply, errors.
- [Connecting Claude Code and Claude Desktop](docs/agents/connect.md): config snippets, flags, HTTP transport.

## MCP tools
- [MCP server contract](docs/specs/ai-integration.md): tools, resources, prompts, schemas and safety rules (sections 8 and 10).
- Tools: describe, open_board, board_summary, list_nets, get_net, stackup, compute_xsection_impedance, impedance_profile, run_erc, list_violations, explain_violation, run_analysis, job_status, cancel_job, get_result, result_summary, export_report, propose_rule_changes, apply_proposal.

## CLI JSON
- [Agent-friendly CLI conventions](docs/specs/ai-integration.md): `--json` envelope, exit codes 0-7, `oa describe`.
